title: Remember expanded/collapsed 'Details' state for file transfer notifications
line: File transfer notifications now open with Details expanded or collapsed the way you last left them.
explanation: Each JobItem's Details button started unchecked, so every new transfer notification (popup or applet entry) opened collapsed and users had to expand it every time. MR !7405 (Peder Bergan) adds a small JobDetailsState singleton that stores the last choice in ~/.local/state/plasmanotificationsstaterc ([Jobs] DetailsExpanded). Each new job view reads it once when created, and only a user toggle writes it, so views of concurrent jobs stay independent and the automatic collapse at job completion doesn't change the saved choice.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: Remember the job details expansion state

Every new transfer notification started with Details collapsed, so users
watching speed or remaining files had to expand it every time. Save the
last Details choice as applet state and use it for each new job view.

BUG: 522935

media.caption: Master: after expanding Details on the previous transfer, the next transfer's popup still opens collapsed
With MR !7405: the next transfer's popup opens with Details expanded (speed chart, source, destination)
Master: the first transfer with Details expanded by hand
With MR !7405: same first transfer, Details expanded by hand (this choice is what gets remembered)
